about_the_game:
Ortunia Mysteries: Where Did Everybody Go? Step into a town steeped in mystery in this 3D escape-room puzzle game.

You play as Draiven, a skilled healer, summoned by your friend Joran to the Unsettled Dragon, a quaint inn at the heart of Ortunia. But when you arrive, Joran is nowhere to be found—and neither is anyone else. The once-lively town stands eerily empty. What happened to Ortunia's residents? Can you uncover the truth?

Armed with only a cryptic letter from Joran, you'll embark on a journey to unravel Ortunia's secrets. Solve challenging puzzles, uncover hidden clues, and navigate through elaborate mazes as you follow in the footsteps of your missing friend and his companions. Will you rise to the challenge?

Features:

  • Six Engaging Chapters: Explore diverse settings, from the mysterious inn to the shadowy catacombs and the grandeur of the cathedral.

  • Puzzle-Packed Adventure: Test your wits with a variety of puzzles that progress the story and reveal Ortunia's secrets.

  • Hidden Secrets & Bonus Content: Can you discover all the secret rooms and unravel their mysteries?

Dare to uncover what’s chasing Joran and his companions—and why. The fate of Ortunia lies in your hands.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K 3.50GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 or equivalent
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Unravel the mystery of Ortunia. Dive into this first-person escape room adventure, solving intricate puzzles and uncovering secrets across eerie locations like catacombs and a grand cathedral. Can you save your friend from the darkness pursuing them?
